about: The source model of a FITS file (spec/virtualize/fits.md §6.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/fits.md#61-elements>): the elements a parser emits, the tables of data types and extension types, and the roles the file, each HDU's header, its mandatory cards, its data and its table play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the FITS convention's layout (spec/virtualize/fits.md §16.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/fits.md#163-checks>). The parser checks them in this order, HDU by HDU; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

data_types.about: BITPIX: Zarr data type, bytes per value (FITS Standard 4.0 §4.4.1.1)

xtensions.about: XTENSION: the kind of extension (FITS Standard 4.0 §7)

elements.about: The IR of a FITS file: one struct per HDU, in file order. k is the HDU's header blocks, D its data bytes, p its padding to the block boundary (shorter at a truncated end of file), N1 and N2 a table's NAXIS1 and NAXIS2, g the bytes between the rows and the heap (THEAP - N1 * N2), H the heap's bytes.

hdus/<i>.extent: the HDU's blocks: from its first header byte to the end of its padding

hdus/<i>/header.extent: (offset, 2880k): the header's blocks, END and blank padding cards included

hdus/<i>/data.form: {geometry: {data_type, shape: [NAXISn, ..., NAXIS1]}, codec: {endian: big}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}
hdus/<i>/data.extent: an image's D bytes, when D > 0

hdus/<i>/rows.extent: a table's N1 * N2 bytes, when not 0

hdus/<i>/gap.extent: the g bytes before the heap, when g > 0

hdus/<i>/pad.extent: the data's padding to the block boundary, when p > 0

gaps/<offset>.about: bytes after the last HDU (special records)

constraints.message: file too short for a 2880-byte FITS block

given.scanned: the bytes scanned for an END card: to the end of the file, or max_header
given.found: whether an END card was found

constraints.message: HDU {hdu}: no END card in the {scanned} bytes from {offset}

given.card: the card's index in the header
given.byte: the byte's index in the card

constraints.message: HDU {hdu}: byte {byte} of card {card} is {shown}, not printable ASCII

given.expected: the keyword the standard requires there

constraints.message: HDU {hdu}: card {position} is {keyword}, not {expected}
HDU {hdu}: {keyword} '{value}' is not an integer
HDU {hdu}: BITPIX {value} is not one of 8, 16, 32, 64, -32, -64
HDU {hdu}: NAXIS {value} is not in 0..999
HDU {hdu}: NAXIS{n} {value} is negative
HDU {hdu}: PCOUNT {value} is negative
HDU {hdu}: GCOUNT {value} is not positive
HDU {hdu}: XTENSION '{name}' is not IMAGE, TABLE or BINTABLE

HDU {hdu}: the {total_shown}-byte data at {offset} is outside the {size}-byte file

HDU {hdu}: a {xtension} with NAXIS {naxis}, not 2
HDU {hdu}: TFIELDS {tfields} is not in 0..999
HDU {hdu}: no TFORM{n} card

given.theap: THEAP, or NAXIS1 * NAXIS2 when absent

constraints.message: HDU {hdu}: THEAP {theap} is less than the rows' {rows} bytes
HDU {hdu}: THEAP {theap} puts the heap past the {pcount}-byte supplement
HDU {hdu}: tile-compressed tables (ZTABLE = T) are not supported
HDU {hdu}: tile-compressed images (ZIMAGE = T) are not supported yet
